newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia produces around 1.58 mln bpd oil in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia produces around 1.58 mln bpd oil in Feb.

text.p: Indonesia produced around 1.58 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil and condensate in February, an oil industry source said on Monday.
"Crude oil production is about 1.41 million bpd in February, including 60,000 bpd for our own use. Condensate production is around 170,000 bpd," the source said.
The source said the 60,000 bpd of crude was used for a steamflood project in the Duri field, in Central Sumatra.
The Duri field, operated by PT Caltex Pacific Indonesia, produces around 280,000 bpd of crude, source said.
Caltex is joinly owned by Chevron Corp and Texaco. The source give no other details.
Indonesia has an OPEC quota of 1.330 million bpd.
